name: aquachain-caliper
description: Caliper benchmarking workspace for AquaChain (Fabric v2.5)

scripts.bench:energy: caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig network-config.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/energy-benchmark.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test --caliper-report-path reports/energy-report.html
scripts.bench:produce: caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig network-config.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/produce-benchmark.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test --caliper-report-path reports/produce-report.html
